papers.lead_zh: 论文针对增材制造里零件几何一变就要重做热仿真、设计评估代价高的问题，提出 Fed-PIGANO：各制造站点在本地训练物理信息几何感知神经算子 PI-GANO，只上传几何编码器与预测网络参数并由服务器聚合，从而在不共享专有零件几何的前提下互相借用几何多样性。摘要报告在二维金属增材稳态热基准上，三个站点、五类多边形几何、四种场景、七次重复下，未见几何上的平均相对 L2 误差为 1.83% 至 2.04%，优于仅本地训练，并与集中式模型相当。
papers.lead_en: Retrieved from arXiv. No AI interpretation is available yet; metadata and abstract are from the source.
papers.abstract_en: In additive manufacturing (AM), each change in part geometry requires a new thermal simulation, which makes design evaluation over many candidates costly. Geometry-aware models reduce this cost by predicting thermal fields on unseen parts with a single learned model, but they assume that diverse geometries are available centrally. This assumption is restrictive when each manufacturing site holds only a limited set of proprietary part designs that it cannot share. We propose Fed-PIGANO, a federated framework that trains physics-informed geometry-aware neural operator (PI-GANO) models at individual sites and aggregates their geometry encoders and prediction networks without sharing part geometries. We evaluate the framework on a 2D steady-state thermal benchmark for metal AM, with geometries from five polygonal families distributed across three sites under four scenarios that range from identical to strongly different family compositions. Over seven replications, Fed-PIGANO achieves mean relative L2 errors of 1.83% to 2.04% across all 12 scenario-site cases, compared with up to 20.46% for local-only training, and consistently yields lower PDE residuals. Its prediction accuracy is comparable to that of a centralized model trained on the pooled geometries of all sites. These results demonstrate that federated learning lets manufacturing sites benefit from each other's geometries without sharing them, enabling rapid thermal prediction on new part designs for tasks such as shape optimization, inverse design, and uncertainty quantification.

papers.lead_zh: 论文针对波束扫描的双站ISAC毫米波链路，研究在AoA/AoD角度功率图上检测多径分量，以支撑无线电SLAM。作者指出非相干积分后噪声服从近似高斯分布，常规单元平均CFAR的指数分布阈值不再成立，因此推导了适配的CFAR检验，并引入多单元待测块和十字形训练窗以降低计算量。在60 GHz室内实测数据上以快照SLAM后端评估，CFAR检测使整体定位RMSE由0.30 m降至0.24至0.26 m。
papers.lead_en: Retrieved from arXiv. No AI interpretation is available yet; metadata and abstract are from the source.
papers.abstract_en: Reliable multipath detection is essential for millimeter-wave simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM), where propagation paths reflecting off the environment provide geometric constraints beyond the dominant line-of-sight component. This paper develops constant false alarm rate (CFAR)-based detectors for beam-swept bistatic integrated sensing and communications (ISAC). Starting from conventional CFAR on the I/Q datacube, we derive a modified detector for non-coherently integrated angular power maps, where the post-integration noise statistics differ from those assumed by standard cell-averaging CFAR. To improve practicality, we introduce a multi-cell cell-under-test formulation and a plus-shaped training window that reduces computational cost while accounting for sidelobe structure. The proposed methods are evaluated on experimental 60 GHz indoor measurements using a snapshot-SLAM estimator. Compared with a singular value decomposition (SVD)-based detector, the proposed CFAR approaches reduce the overall positioning RMSE from 0.30 m to 0.24-0.26 m, with the largest improvement in non-line-of-sight snapshots. The multi-cell non-coherent detector further lowers the computational complexity without degrading positioning accuracy, demonstrating its suitability for practical multipath radio-SLAM.

analysis.title_zh: 面向毫米波无线电SLAM的非相干积分角度图CFAR检测
analysis.summary: 论文针对波束扫描的双站ISAC毫米波链路，研究在AoA/AoD角度功率图上检测多径分量，以支撑无线电SLAM。作者指出非相干积分后噪声服从近似高斯分布，常规单元平均CFAR的指数分布阈值不再成立，因此推导了适配的CFAR检验，并引入多单元待测块和十字形训练窗以降低计算量。在60 GHz室内实测数据上以快照SLAM后端评估，CFAR检测使整体定位RMSE由0.30 m降至0.24至0.26 m。
analysis.question: 在波束扫描毫米波ISAC系统中，如何仅依赖角度功率图可靠检测较弱多径分量，替代只保留主分量的SVD检测，并避免逐RE检测的计算开销。
analysis.method: 从I/Q数据立方体出发，利用平方律样本的指数分布建立单视CFAR；对非相干积分的角度功率图，按Erlang/高斯统计修改阈值；将待测区域扩展为多单元块，每次只评估一个统计量并记录在最强单元；采用十字形训练窗匹配AoA/AoD轴向旁瓣结构；最后与SVD检测在同一快照SLAM后端上对比。
analysis.transfer: 推断：将检测统计量按积分后分布重新推导、并用结构化训练窗抑制旁瓣的思路，可迁移到GNSS多径/信号质量监测与多传感器融合中的异常回波筛选；但其在电离层TEC/ROTI时序或机器人学习任务中的有效性未经验证。
limitations: 提供的来源为摘要与部分HTML正文，未覆盖完整实验章节、参数设置与SLAM后端细节，不能视为精读全文。
提供的来源未说明数据集规模、快照数量、训练/测试划分与统计显著性。
提供的来源未说明CFAR的具体阈值因子、虚警率取值、训练窗尺寸和计算量绝对值。
提供的来源未说明除定位RMSE外的检测性能指标，如检测概率、虚警率实测值。
S2中NLOS数值在抓取文本中存在排版错乱，0.38/0.29与摘要所述改进方向不一致，需以原文核对。
practical_steps: 核对非相干积分样本数NRS与高斯近似的适用条件。
复现时先确认CFAR阈值因子、目标虚警率与训练窗/保护带尺寸，来源未给出的配置不可假设。
确认SVD基线与所提方法使用相同的快照SLAM后端和相同数据划分。
复现计算量对比时明确统计的是检测统计量评估次数而非实际运行时间。
以原文排版正确的版本核对NLOS RMSE数值后再引用。

findings.statement: 与SVD检测相比，所提CFAR方法使整体定位RMSE从0.30 m降至0.24至0.26 m，且NLOS快照改善最大。
findings.quote: Compared with a singular value decomposition (SVD)-based detector, the proposed CFAR approaches reduce the overall positioning RMSE from 0.30 m to 0.24-0.26 m, with the largest improvement in non-line-of-sight snapshots.

findings.statement: 多单元非相干CFAR在保持定位精度的同时降低计算复杂度。
findings.quote: The multi-cell non-coherent detector further lowers the computational complexity without degrading positioning accuracy, demonstrating its suitability for practical multipath radio-SLAM.

findings.statement: 正文称多单元非相干CFAR相比逐RE CFAR加二进制积分，所需检测统计量评估次数少约三个数量级。

papers.lead_en: Retrieved from arXiv. No AI interpretation is available yet; metadata and abstract are from the source.
papers.abstract_en: We present Meituan-Robotics-0 (MR0), a vision-language-action foundation model and embodied-agent system for stationary-base desktop manipulation. MR0 combines 147 million vision-language samples with 15,060 hours of curated robot trajectories spanning 12 embodiments. A three-stage training recipe aligns multimodal representations with robot behavior through discrete action-token pre-training, transfers these priors to continuous cross-embodiment control through flow-matching mid-training, and adapts the policy through real-world post-training. We introduce Rollback, which pairs replaced policy segments with human corrections to provide positive and negative supervision for CFG-DAgger without value learning or advantage labeling. A unified end-effector interface supports heterogeneous embodiments, while asynchronous action-chunk merging maintains smooth execution under variable inference latency. An event-driven agent maintains persistent task events and reassesses plans when progress or feasibility changes, enabling cross-task retrieval and conditional task resumption. MR0 achieves 93.6% success on RoboTwin 2.0 and ranks fifth in the RoboDojo VLA track. Under matched HG-DAgger post-training, MR0 achieves higher average success rate and progress score than $π_{0.5}$ across three real-robot tasks. On Ethernet insertion, CFG-DAgger trained with Rollback data reaches 70% success and a progress score of 0.90. Qualitative agent deployments demonstrate cross-task event retrieval and recovery from temporarily unsatisfied task conditions.

papers.lead_zh: 该论文从间隔（margin）角度为 LoRA 的两个经验现象提供统一理论解释：对灾难性遗忘的鲁棒性和独立训练适配器的可合并性。作者在多类线性分类、近正交任务与 ℓ2 正则条件下刻画最优 LoRA 适配器，指出在中间正则区间最优解对齐微调数据的最大间隔方向，并由此推导预训练与微调数据上的闭式间隔表达式及合并模型的间隔与最优混合系数，提出免训练的间隔式 LoRA 合并规则 MaLoRA。实验称其在视觉与语言分类任务上匹配或优于若干适配器合并基线。
papers.lead_en: Retrieved from arXiv. No AI interpretation is available yet; metadata and abstract are from the source.
papers.abstract_en: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) is the de facto method for parameter-efficient fine-tuning of large neural networks, achieving strong task adaptation with minimal trainable parameters and low optimization cost. Beyond this efficiency, practitioners have observed two striking properties: \textit{robustness to catastrophic forgetting} and the ability to \textit{merge independently trained adapters} into a single model that performs competitively across multiple tasks. These properties are central to continual and multi-task learning, yet remain poorly understood. In this work, we provide a theoretical explanation through a unified \textit{margin-based perspective}. We analyze LoRA in multiclass linear classification under a near-orthogonal task regime with $\ell_2$-regularization, and characterize the optimal LoRA adapter across regularization regimes. Our analysis shows that, in an intermediate regime of regularization parameters, the optimal adapter aligns with the \emph{max-margin solution} on the fine-tuning data. Building on this characterization, we derive two key consequences. First, we obtain closed-form expressions for the margins on pre-training and fine-tuning data, revealing a precise margin trade-off: the regularization parameter controls the balance between retention and adaptation. Second, we analyze adapter merging, proving that merged models achieve positive margin on each task and deriving optimal mixing coefficients that balance margins across tasks and maximize the margin over their union. These results lead to a simple, training-free merging rule, which we term \textit{margin-based LoRA merging} (MaLoRA). Experiments on modern architectures and real datasets validate our theoretical predictions, showing that MaLoRA matches or outperforms several adapter-merging baselines across a range of vision and language classification tasks.

analysis.title_zh: LoRA 的间隔视角：对灾难性遗忘的鲁棒性与适配器合并（MaLoRA）
analysis.summary: 该论文从间隔（margin）角度为 LoRA 的两个经验现象提供统一理论解释：对灾难性遗忘的鲁棒性和独立训练适配器的可合并性。作者在多类线性分类、近正交任务与 ℓ2 正则条件下刻画最优 LoRA 适配器，指出在中间正则区间最优解对齐微调数据的最大间隔方向，并由此推导预训练与微调数据上的闭式间隔表达式及合并模型的间隔与最优混合系数，提出免训练的间隔式 LoRA 合并规则 MaLoRA。实验称其在视觉与语言分类任务上匹配或优于若干适配器合并基线。
analysis.question: 为何 LoRA 在显著适配后仍对灾难性遗忘有鲁棒性，并能将不同任务独立训练的适配器合并为在多任务上表现良好的单一模型；这两个现象此前缺乏理论解释。
analysis.method: 在多类线性分类、微调样本彼此及与预训练样本近正交的设定下，对带 ℓ2 正则的 LoRA 目标分析全局最优解，按正则强度分区间刻画适配器方向；据此刻画预训练、微调及并集上的归一化间隔，导出间隔权衡与最大化并集间隔的正则参数；再对每个任务处于中间区间的情形推导合并模型各任务间隔与最优混合系数的闭式表达，形成免训练合并规则 MaLoRA，并在视觉与语言分类任务上做数值验证。
analysis.transfer: 推断：间隔与正则权衡的视角可类比到 GNSS 定位与电离层预测中的增量微调，例如用适配器范数比与验证间隔监测新任务微调对旧场景精度的侵蚀；其免训练加权合并思路或可用于合并不同测站、不同时段训练的小型适配器。以上仅为方法类比，论文未涉及时序定位或电离层数据。

papers.lead_en: Retrieved from arXiv. No AI interpretation is available yet; metadata and abstract are from the source.
papers.abstract_en: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) have recently been applied to epidemic modeling and forecasting with promising results. These methods integrate mechanistic knowledge with data-driven learning. Yet, their comparative performance against well-established, and simpler epidemic models is underexplored. Here, we conduct a systematic comparison of a PINN-based framework and a stochastic mechanistic model. Both approaches share the same age-structured SEIRD core and rolling-window forecasting pipeline, in a deliberately minimal setting. We evaluate their retrospective fits and probabilistic forecasts in two synthetic scenarios and the first COVID-19 wave in London. Interestingly, while PINNs underperform in synthetic scenarios, they achieve better performance on real data. Furthermore, PINNs provide narrower uncertainty intervals and sharper estimation of parameters in synthetic scenarios. Our findings confirm PINNs as a promising tool in epidemiology. At the same time, the results reaffirm the value of simpler approaches such as traditional compartmental models, and promote additional benchmarking studies.

papers.lead_en: Retrieved from arXiv. No AI interpretation is available yet; metadata and abstract are from the source.
papers.abstract_en: Photorealistic and metrically consistent world representations are a primary requirement for LiDAR--inertial--visual SLAM systems that serve robots over continuous operation. 3D Gaussian splatting makes such representations attainable by supplying an explicit, renderable, and queryable scene model. We present GEMOR-GS (Global Extrinsic-calibration-refined Mapping and Online Relocalization for 3D Gaussian-Splatting SLAM) to make the Gaussian map geometrically accurate, globally refined, and re-enterable, providing a better appearance for robot perception and decision-making. To improve the 3DGS map, the LiDAR--camera extrinsic is first estimated offline by direct-method alignment over dedicated calibration segments and reused by all following online and offline processes. Under the calibrated geometry, keyframe poses and Gaussian parameters are refined alternately under a gated differentiable-rendering and LiDAR--projection objective. The final global reconstruction is then rebuilt from the refined keyframe schema with all online constraints lifted. For the robot SLAM lifecycle, the method recovers the pose from the 3DGS map after tracking loss through an XFeat bypass map, RANSAC-PnP coarse localization, and Gaussian RGB-D warp refinement. Experiments on one self-collected and five public sequences quantify each element: the offline reconstruction wins all paired keyframes against the online map by 14.3--19.9 dB, improves PSNR by approximately 9 dB over Gaussian-LIC2, and achieves 86--100% held-out relocalization success tied to extrinsic quality. The results show that GEMOR-GS improves the geometric accuracy, appearance fidelity, and re-enterability of the 3DGS map, serving as a dependable robot world model for SLAM and downstream tasks.

papers.lead_en: Retrieved from arXiv. No AI interpretation is available yet; metadata and abstract are from the source.
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are trained as general-purpose foundation models for robot learning, and require fine-tuning for each downstream task and robot. This raises practical questions such as how much data and training updates are needed, how checkpoints should be selected, and whether simulation can be leveraged to alleviate the cost of real data collection. We study these questions on a task that requires both precise manipulation and spatial understanding of the scene. In this task, an SO-101 arm moves a chess king between two squares that are given only by their names, such as e4 and a5. We fine-tune $π_{0.5}$ with various dataset sizes and update budgets, using teleoperated demonstrations as well as simulated demonstrations from a randomized scripted expert that imitates the variability of human demonstrations. In simulation, the success rate scales with both data and updates. Importantly, we find that a short learning-rate cool-down adds up to 31 points and is necessary for comparing checkpoints, and that validation loss and action error are unreliable for model selection. On the real arm, we fine-tune on up to 256 teleoperated demonstrations and evaluate ten policies in 25 trials each. Partial results indicate that pretraining on the simulated demonstrations helps substantially, most clearly when real data is scarce. We also present a negative result, in which training on the policy's own rollouts with filtered behavior cloning, RECAP-style advantage conditioning, corrections from an automatic coach, or residual reinforcement learning did not yield a measurable improvement over plain behavior cloning in our setting. We release the simulator, the expert and the real demonstrations.

papers.lead_en: Retrieved from arXiv. No AI interpretation is available yet; metadata and abstract are from the source.
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) is now a standard stage of language model post-training, and the compute devoted to it is growing rapidly. While it has been shown to improve capabilities, particularly for tasks with verifiable rewards, it can also change behaviours and internal properties that the reward does not explicitly target. We present a formalism to describe the evolution of "traits" during RL post-training and, in doing so, recover the Price equation from evolutionary biology. We use this to develop a mathematical model for what we call "trait hitchhiking": the amplification or suppression of non-targeted traits as training redistributes probability across completions. We evaluate this Price update expression on language models trained with GRPO and show that the Price estimates closely track the sampled trait dynamics. These results identify trait hitchhiking as a mechanism by which RL post-training can silently amplify undesirable traits.
